messages:
Maria (arch): Quick RFC follow-up — I propose coalescing several longtail enrichment slices (persona-enricher, metadata-augment, locale-normalize) into a single 'enrichment-core' service. Goal: reduce N-hop calls, centralize telemetry, and make a bounded surface for caching. Posting a short plan and open questions.

Simon: Reasonable high-level. Biggest tradeoff I'm worried about is blast radius — a single deploy could affect many tenants. Have we scoped rollback and isolation?

Tara: Also thinking about p99 tail. If enrichment-core touches hotpath, we can't add >30ms to critical endpoints. Need latency budget and a way to short-circuit for light requests.

Devon: Operational pattern suggestion: keep per-slice adapter façades (thin proxies) that call enrichment-core behind a feature flag. That gives us a safe rollout path and per-tenant routing. Example shim (very small):
```
// old handler
resp = call('persona-enricher', payload)
// new handler (adapter façade)
resp = call('enrichment-core', {slice: 'persona', payload})
```
This keeps contract stable while centralizing logic.

Jess - Infra: 👍 We'll need to size enrichment-core differently: persona-enricher currently spikes during nightly batches. Can we define expected QPS and batch windows so infra can provision correctly? I'll run a profiling pass.

deploy-bot: CI: 97% unit tests passed for branch "enrichment/core-skel" — https://ci.internal/reports/5123

Maria (arch): Draft rollout plan: 
1) Create enrichment-core repo and implement core API + feature-gated adapters (no behavior change).
2) Merge adapter shims in slices behind FF = off.
3) Turn FF on for 1% tenants (canary) with dedicated canary k8s namespace + traffic mirror.
4) Observe metrics for 48h; if green expand to 10% and run another observation window.
5) Full migration + decommission old services.
Estimated timeline: 6 weeks to get through step 3, 2 additional weeks for full migration assuming no regressions.

Simon: Guardrails we should automate: immediate rollback if (a) p95 delta > 15ms, (b) error rate increase > 0.2% absolute, (c) increase in request queue length indicating backpressure. Also capture tenant error spikes.

Tara: Suggest refining numbers: gate for p95 delta < 10ms, keep error-rate threshold at 0.1% absolute, and CPU headroom >= 25% for canary pods. Also add a fallback: if enrichment-core is slow, adapters should return cached / best-effort response.

Devon: I'll draft the PR sequence and a migration playbook. Plan: separate PRs — (A) core API + tests, (B) adapter shims, (C) enable FF routing + observability. Keeps changes reviewable.

Jess - Infra: I'll provision a canary namespace, wire up synthetic traffic, and put cost/scale estimates in the ticket. I'll own the rollout runbook and the automated rollback hooks.

Maria (arch): Next steps / owners: Devon = PR skeleton + playbook; Jess = canary infra + cost estimate; Tara = metric thresholds + evaluation prompt set; Simon = risk review + rollback thresholds. I'll add this to next Wed arch sync and create an ADR stub. Please ping the thread with any blocking concerns. :thumbsup:
